From fea3fdf975dd9f3e5248afaab8fe023db313f005 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jiasheng Jiang <jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2021 09:41:26 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/ast: potential dereference of null pointer

The return value of kzalloc() needs to be checked.
To avoid use of null pointer '&ast_state->base' in case of the
failure of alloc.

Fixes: f0adbc382b8b ("drm/ast: Allocate initial CRTC state of the correct size")
Signed-off-by: Jiasheng Jiang <jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20211214014126.2211535-1-jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
index 1e30eaeb0e1b..d5c98f79d58d 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
@@ -1121,7 +1121,10 @@ static void ast_crtc_reset(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 	if (crtc->state)
 		crtc->funcs->atomic_destroy_state(crtc, crtc->state);
 
-	__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	if (ast_state)
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	else
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
 }
 
 static struct drm_crtc_state *
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c`**
   - The function `ast_crtc_reset` was modified to include a null pointer check for `ast_state` before dereferencing it.
   - The line that previously called `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);` was changed to:
     ```c
     if (ast_state)
         __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
     else
         __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
     ```
   - This ensures that if `ast_state` is null (indicating a failure in memory allocation), the function will not attempt to dereference it, thus preventing a potential null pointer dereference.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `ast_mode.c` directly addresses a potential bug related to dereferencing a null pointer that could occur if the memory allocation for `ast_state` fails. By adding the null check, the patch enhances the robustness of the code, ensuring that the function can handle cases where `ast_state` is not properly initialized. This change is a preventive measure against runtime errors that could arise from the previous implementation.

Here is the commit message:
drm/ast: potential dereference of null pointer

The return value of kzalloc() needs to be checked.
To avoid use of null pointer '&ast_state->base' in case of the
failure of alloc.

Fixes: f0adbc382b8b ("drm/ast: Allocate initial CRTC state of the correct size")
Signed-off-by: Jiasheng Jiang <jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20211214014126.2211535-1-jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the lack of a null pointer check after the allocation of memory for `ast_state`. If the memory allocation fails, `ast_state` would be null, leading to a dereference of a null pointer when attempting to access `&ast_state->base`, which can cause a crash or undefined behavior in the program.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void ast_crtc_reset(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 {
 	struct ast_crtc_state *ast_state =
 		kzalloc(sizeof(*ast_state), GFP_KERNEL);
 
 	if (crtc->state)
 		crtc->funcs->atomic_destroy_state(crtc, crtc->state);
 
-	__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	if (ast_state)
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	else
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
struct ast_crtc_state *ast_state =
    kzalloc(sizeof(*ast_state), GFP_KERNEL);
__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because there is no check to see if `ast_state` is null after the memory allocation with `kzalloc()`. If the allocation fails, `ast_state` will be null, and dereferencing `&ast_state->base` will lead to a null pointer dereference, causing a crash or undefined behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (ast_state)
    __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
else
    __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
```
Reason:
The fix introduces a null pointer check for `ast_state` before dereferencing it. If `ast_state` is null, it safely calls `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL)`, preventing a null pointer dereference and ensuring that the program can handle the memory allocation failure gracefully.
